_comment: Sample business of the showcase (09 §8.19, ADR-412, M4.14): an obviously fictional workshop name, placeholder Impressum data marked as a sample on the page (is_sample), owned by the SPEED CLUB Editorial account, cover from the graded seed photos (design/seed-photos/processed, cover-workshop-*, used by no other sample). The street and the register number are placeholders, not a real company or house; the coordinates are the city area. `portfolio`: how many Editorial builds with a linked suspension part join its portfolio (both sides are the Editorial account, so the tag is confirmed). No ratings, no reviews, no counts beyond the real portfolio (hidden on samples).
